title: The fitness staff want a time trial
text: A two-kilometre time trial in the middle of the season. It tells you who's fit; nobody loves it.

text: {first} has packed on muscle over the summer and it shows in the contested work. The gym staff want to keep pushing him; the physio would rather hold the weight where it is.

effects.why: You listened to the physio about his body

title: The pre-season camp
text: The leaders want to get the group away before the last block. There are three ways to spend it.

choices.label: A hard camp
choices.result: Three days of sand hills, two-a-days and sore bodies.

choices.label: A bonding camp

effects.why: A team camp away together in pre-season

choices.result: Three days away together, with more laughs than running.

choices.label: Stay home and drill the plan
choices.result: A week at the club, running the plan until it's second nature.

choices.result: The premiers get a few more easy weeks, and the running waits.
